# A Moment's Pause

Between the breath you're taking now
and the one that follows soon,
there lives a quiet, gentle space—
like starlight after moon.

The world keeps spinning, fast and loud,
with all its noise and haste,
but here, right here, in this small pause,
there's nothing to be chased.

So let the minutes drift along
like leaves on autumn streams,
and trust that even resting hearts
still get to keep their dreams.
